name: Mylapore Express Salesforce Agentforce Spec Pack
limitations: No Salesforce org or Copado workspace was accessed or audited.
Agentforce, Messaging, Lightning Types, Omni-Channel and API entitlements must be verified in target org.
OpenAPI is a baseline catalogue; complete schemas and contract tests are required before production.
Exact Agentforce metadata support and Copado pipeline behavior depend on org/API version and product edition.
No executable Apex/LWC production implementation is included; this pack is the specification and sprint plan.
